get.description: Lists BIM Levels associated with the specified Project.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description:
The compact view contains only ids.
The extended view contains the response shown below.
The normal view contains 'bim_file_id', 'location_id', and 'created_by_id' instead of embedded objects.
The default view is normal.

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[bim_file_id]
parameters.description: Filter item(s) with matching BIM File ids

parameters.name: filters[location_id]
parameters.description: Location ID. Returns item(s) with the specified Location ID or a range of Location IDs.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort item(s) by an attribute. The default sort is ascending. To sort in descending order, prepend the sort value with a hyphen character '-'

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

bim_file_id.description: ID of the BIM Model revision linked to the Level

location_id.description: ID of location linked to the Level

created_by_id.description: ID of user that created the level

name.description: Name of the file to be associated to a project

uuid.description: Unique UUID associated with the file

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last update to Location

code.description: The unique code for this Location

id.description: Login Information ID uniquely identifying this user.

name.description: User's display name, formatted first name then last name.

company_name.description: User Company name. If the user belongs to a vendor, the vendor name will be returned.

locale.description: IETF locale code for the user's language preference (e.g., 'en', 'ko'). Null when the user has not set a locale.

403.description: User does not have permission to view BIM Levels

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.
A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.
